summary: TokHealth Auth & Family Features Testing Complete - All 20 backend tests passed, Frontend auth and family flows verified working. Users Meka and JJ already linked as family members.

issues: Console warning: 'Received true for non-boolean attribute jsx' - minor React/styled-jsx warning, not affecting functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Auth system properly handles token-based authentication with Bearer token support
Family linking system correctly uses bidirectional links (from_user_id, to_user_id)
Token expiry set to 30 days is reasonable for health app
Password hashing uses SHA-256 with salt - adequate for demo, consider bcrypt for production
All auth endpoints properly return 401 for invalid/missing tokens
Family dashboard correctly shows 'is_self' flag and health_zone for each member
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testability
